name: audio_buf
doc: One buffer slot of an AudioOut (src/audio/out.ts). Reclaimed: the slot holds no buffer (never used, or the game took the buffer back). Appended: queued, not a byte consumed. Playing: the consumer (silent sink or device mixer) is inside it; a change of consumer leaves it here with its position. Released: played to the end, or returned by a Stop or a purge (Flush), and waiting in the released queue for GetReleasedAudioOutBuffer. Drop is a Close with released buffers nobody took. A buffer is released exactly once because Finish and Flush leave Appended and Playing only.
